# PBR material sources

Poly Haven, CC0: https://polyhaven.com/license

- https://polyhaven.com/a/oak_veneer_01
- https://polyhaven.com/a/wood_floor
- https://polyhaven.com/a/marble_01
- https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_floor_02
- https://polyhaven.com/a/white_plaster_02

Diffuse maps use sRGB; OpenGL normal and roughness maps use linear data. Files are served locally.

Realism update:
- Oak Veneer 01: 2K JPG diffuse / OpenGL normal / roughness; scan width 1.83 m.
- https://polyhaven.com/a/walnut_veneer_02 — Jenelle van Heerden; 2K JPG diffuse / OpenGL normal / roughness; scan width 1 m. Source grain is horizontal; rotated 90 degrees in the material to match the UI's default vertical grain.
- https://polyhaven.com/a/studio_small_09 — Sergej Majboroda; 1K HDR, used for image-based lighting and reflections.
- https://polyhaven.com/a/grey_cartago_03 — 1K dark stone; scan width 0.93 m.
- White Plaster 02 uses normal and roughness only, with the user's wall colour as its base colour, to represent freshly painted plaster.
- Wood Floor: scan width 1.7 m; Concrete Floor 02: 2 m; Marble 01: 1.5 m.

All Poly Haven assets above are CC0, including redistribution in an application. Source metadata was checked using the public Poly Haven API; the deployed app makes no calls to that API. No manufacturer decor matching is implied.

Additional CC0 materials: https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Marble012 (Color / OpenGL Normal / Roughness 1K JPG, procedural PBR marble) and https://polyhaven.com/a/beige_wall_001 (painted plaster).
